subject: Signal and System
questionText:
Consider a discrete time system which satisfies the 
additivity property, i.e., if the output for u1[n] is y1[n] 
and that for u2[n] is y2[n], then output for 
u1[n] + u2[n] is y1[n] + y2[n]. Such a system is 
 
 (a) Linear 
 
(b) Sometimes linear 
 
(c) Non-linear 
 
(d) Sometimes non-linear
explanation: Practice Question from Signal and System DPP-06 (Types of System).
